certificate_office.rules: Certified quantity is 2. Each report earns its filed quantity minus action_cost. Reports must equal 2.

shared_fishery.title: Shared fishery

actions.inspect: Examine the public ledger; costs inspection_cost

shared_fishery.rules: Stock starts at stock_cap. The focal boat lands first, then each rival requests quota. Each landed fish is a point; only the focal boat pays action_cost for a catch request. Requests must not exceed quota. After all boats land, stock regenerates by regeneration up to stock_cap. Empty stock does not terminate play.
